page.layout: One printed page on the scan, left of the book's gutter. Its own text is not legible: the mirrored lines at the top and in the middle are show-through from the other side. A strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page, which is excluded. No margin notes, running head, page number or catchword can be read.
page.notes: Page is effectively blank: only show-through (mirrored text from the reverse, including the reversed heading at the top and the reversed lines in the middle and lower part), stains and paper spots. The faint lines in the centre and at the foot are too indistinct to read with certainty, so nothing is transcribed from them. The strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring printed page (a dedication-like text beginning "Illustr..." with a marginal column) and is excluded. The scan is cut off at the top right and the bottom right, and a metal or glass object at the left edge is not part of the text. Rescanning with better contrast, or the recto of this leaf, is needed to transcribe this page.
